As.bar_b_note: B's larger blue-grey panel with gold ingredient lines approaches a shipping HUD, but the small white glyph prompts with no teal interaction accent and A's tiny clipped text keep the set below Palworld's HUD finish.

Zv.bar_b_note: A's timber frame, cross brace, cap board and stone footing read as built, but the flat pale infill, the smooth faceted boulder beside it and the painted-card mountains sit below Palworld's base-building finish, and B is a blown-out white card.

Xs.bar_b_note: B's plank lining and lit stone hearth give a warm Valheim-like interior glow, but neither side shows any storm phase or Stormwood identity (no purple light, copper or glass, no rain or lightning at the window) and dressing stays sparse.

Xw.bar_b_note: A clean, appealing, finished elder villager with readable eyes, earthy moss-green and leather palette and a clear full-body silhouette, held back only by a rounder animated-film face style than the key art's trainer.

Me.bar_b_note: The fixed purple sky, rain and white-violet lightning in the break frames carry the storm mood, but a uniform dark grass carpet, a flat grey distance plane and a tiny or off-frame heartstone sink it against Palworld's dense, landmarked fields.

Mt.bar_b_note: The ring walkway, glowing root cracks and wisps hint at the board's 'ascend the core', but the hollow is a dark, smooth, underlit drum with no visible lightning core, banners or carved bark, and the fading-phase fog is opaque white blobs, so it reads well below Valheim-class interior light.

Vr.bar_b_note: B's naturalistic boar fur and grounded faint poses approach the owner's Stormursa/Stormcapra bar, but its blotchy yellow back clumps and only trainer-height scale keep it short, and A's glossy terracotta clay body with stuck-on moss reads like a ceramic toy, not a Palworld-class creature.

top_changes.change: Build the Stormwood hero landmarks to their boards: a Stormheart hollow with carved dark bark, railed platforms, banners, lanterns and a visible white-violet lightning core column, and a crown heartstone as a large faceted crystal set in a rock crown that stays in frame at every camera

Break the Stormwood ground carpet and drive the light by storm phase: moss, soil and rock patches, black pools and groves instead of uniform dark grass; a phase-graded purple/violet key with lightning flashes on terrain; replace the opaque white fog-blob cards with soft volumetric ground fog

Give built spaces textured, lived-in materials: wattle/plank or daub infill with value variation on the homestead wall, and on the Ashfoot shelter plank-lined gables, Stormwood copper and glass accents, a rain-streaked storm-lit window and more dressing (tools, rugs, hanging herbs) around the hearth
